name: Dual Wielder
summary: +1 Str or Dex; Bonus Action extra attack with any non-Two-Handed melee weapon, and draw or stow two weapons at once.

benefits.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
benefits.summary: After attacking with a Light weapon, make a Bonus Action attack with a different non-Two-Handed melee weapon.
benefits.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the Light property, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later that turn with a different weapon, which must be a Melee weapon without the Two-Handed property. You don't add your ability modifier to this extra attack's damage unless the modifier is negative.

benefits.name: Quick Draw
benefits.summary: Draw or stow two non-Two-Handed weapons when you could normally handle one.
benefits.text: You can draw or stow two weapons that lack the Two-Handed property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.
